text:
Plan Meridian's 24 modules. Final values only; withdrawn drafts are void.

Fixed: tenant/checkout timeout 70; pricing timeout 120, queue 250; indexer timeout 55; backup timeout 110; shipping timeout 30, ttl 450; export ttl 480; media ttl 600; archive batch 900; ledger workers 16; audit workers 8; inventory queue 490; billing queue 270; reports retry 8.

Must hold (all triggered): backup>100: indexer batch≤200. tenant>60: profile ttl≥540. shipping>15: gateway workers≥28. indexer>45: profile batch≥900. export ttl>450: media queue≤10. billing queue>240: tenant retry≤2. pricing>105: auth ttl≤60. shipping ttl>420: sync queue≥480.

Owners exclusive: alpha (tenant, indexer); beta (billing); gamma (webhooks, search); delta (profile, reports, notify).

Together: tenant+checkout, billing+media, backup+quota, inventory+shipping. Apart: backup/media, auth/cache, alerts/archive, indexer/shipping.

Dependencies: auth→search,shipping; tenant→archive; billing→inventory; webhooks→media; notify→audit; gateway→search; profile→inventory. Order: alerts before webhooks; billing before tenant; audit before sync; gateway before cache. No path: reports/notify, quota/gateway, archive/sync, indexer/auth.

Files: rules.py→sync; bench.py→media; specs.py→inventory; guard.py, flags.py→audit; client.py→quota; forms.py→webhooks; views.py→reports.

Rest: your judgment. Output: work plan.
